environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed in isolated account with defense-in-depth. The execution environment uses IMDSv2 (HttpTokens=required, hop-limit=1) enforced via SCP on the organization OU (scp-imdsv2-enforce policy denying ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions unless HttpTokens=required). Additionally, the Lambda VPC has a Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall with rule group association that blocks DNS responses containing link-local addresses (169.254.0.0/16) and RFC1918 ranges in A/AAAA records via a custom managed domain list with action BLOCK (response NXDOMAIN). The API Gateway deployment uses a request validator with body schema requiring 'webhookUrl' to match a pre-registered allowlist stored in a DynamoDB table (validated via VTL mapping template with #set($allowedHosts = ...) pattern). SRI integrity values for each plugin are stored in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store and compared at load time - however this check is performed AFTER the fetch (as visible in the code computing hash post-download), so it serves as detection not prevention for the plugin loading path.

config.api_gateway_validator: request body schema with webhookUrl allowlist via VTL
config.sri_parameter_store: /plugins/integrity/{name} - sha384 hashes checked post-fetch for alerting
